title: Five hundred and one.
date: Tue 10 Nov 2026 (eve of Bhai Dooj, Wed 11 Nov)
caption:
Bhai Dooj maths: the envelope has said ₹501 since 2009, and the one-rupee coin is still taped to the outside.

This year, put a heart inside. Mirror-polished beads, a gold tone toggle and one puffed heart at the front. Heartbead Bracelet, ₹1,299. The heart is shown larger; it is about 15mm.

If it reaches her after Bhai Dooj, tell her the envelope was the trailer.

Today's mangal: Hindi, मंगल.

[ heartbead bracelet · two-tone · ends in one, as it should ]
first_comment: Tag the brother who still gives ₹501. #NairaFlore #BhaiDooj #GiftForSister #HeartBracelet #DemiFineJewellery
alt_text: On a blush ground, a drawn deep-red shagun envelope seen from the back with its flap closed, the flap's two edges lined in gold foil, a gold foil border round the envelope, the word Shubh in Devanagari on its lower right, and a one-rupee coin, the rupee sign over a 1, taped to the flap. A real bracelet of mirror-polished beads runs out from under both edges of the flap, and its gold tone toggle and puffed heart spill out over the flap's point, the heart hanging over the envelope's lower edge. Text: House rule N° 06, Bhai Dooj. Shagun always ends in one. Five hundred and one. Naira, Mangal, and mangal in Hindi script, beside a small steel key.
The Heartbead Bracelet on a cream plaster cube, its gold tone toggle and puffed heart hanging over the front. Text: She feeds you mithai. You bring the heart. It is only fair.

A close photograph of the Heartbead Bracelet on a pale plaster block: grey mirror-polished beads, the gold tone toggle and the puffed heart at the front. Text: Two metals, but only just. Mirror-polished beads, about 6 mm. Gold tone toggle, one puffed heart about 15 mm. Heartbead Bracelet, ₹1,299. Two-tone, demi-fine. Naira, Mangal, and mangal in Hindi script, beside a small steel key.
